voice.welcome: Welcome to Pouring Station! Pick what you would like to pour.
voice.water-intro: Water swishes smoothly. Lift the pitcher and pour to the glowing line.
voice.beans-intro: Beans go clink, clink! Tilt slowly and listen.
voice.rice-intro: Rice whispers softly. Pour a little at a time.
voice.first-pour: Hold the pitcher. Move it toward the cup, then tip it.
voice.steady: Slow and steady. Your hands are in charge.
voice.line-two: Beautiful stop. Ready for one more cup?
voice.water-cheer: Wonderful water pouring! Your hands were calm and steady.
voice.beans-cheer: Lovely bean pouring! You listened and stopped with care.
voice.rice-cheer: Wonderful rice pouring! Tiny grains, careful hands.
voice.tidy: A tiny drip! Maya has the cloth. All tidy.

modes.title: Water
modes.skill: smooth sustained tilt and stopping at a visual line

modes.title: Beans
modes.skill: controlled dry pouring with auditory feedback

modes.title: Rice
modes.skill: fine stop-and-start control with small grains
